name: codex-account-manager
description: Local companion for Codex Account Manager: active profile status and automatic Codex refresh.

scripts.package: npm run build && vsce package --no-dependencies --out codex-account-manager-0.1.0.vsix

commands.title: Codex Account Manager: Show Connection Status

codexAccountManager.autoReloadCodex.description: Restart the extension host after the global account changes. This can interrupt extension tasks.

codexAccountManager.showStatusBar.description: Show local manager connection and current profile.

codexAccountManager.debugLogging.description: Write connection categories only; no account credentials or payloads.
